title: Abyssal Claims: source code of a FAIR-aligned integration platform for deep-sea and terrestrial mining transparency
description:
Source code of Abyssal Claims, an independently developed, non-commercial web platform that integrates more than fifty publicly funded and open-licensed geospatial datasets onto a single interactive three-dimensional globe, making the environmental and governance context of deep-sea mineral extraction and terrestrial industrial mining legible to researchers, journalists, policy analysts and the general public.

This record archives the software: a React + deck.gl frontend, a FastAPI + PostGIS backend, roughly 110 data-source synchronisation pipelines, an MVT tile server, baked raster field layers, an Area Export tool, a documented public read API, and the editorial and provenance logic that keeps the presentation neutral.

No scientific data is included. Every layer is fetched at runtime from its upstream provider and remains under that provider's own licence; the repository carries only source code and a small set of test fixtures. The per-source licence map, including non-commercial and mandatory-citation sources, is in DATA-LICENCES.md.

The methods, data sources, refresh strategies, derived products, known limitations and licensing model are documented separately in the companion deposit, doi:10.5281/zenodo.19745884 (CC-BY-4.0). This software record and that documentation record are two halves of one pair: cite the documentation for the method, this record for the code.
